msg: OSSRH endpoint oss.sonatype.org — Sonatype closed it to releases on 2025-06-30. Deploy to the Central Portal (central.sonatype.com) instead.
nexus-staging-maven-plugin was retired with OSSRH. Replace it with central-publishing-maven-plugin.
A -SNAPSHOT version cannot be released: Central rejects the bundle, and a SNAPSHOT dependency makes the release unbuildable for everyone else.
Plain http:// repository URL. Maven 3.8.1 and later block insecure mirrors, so the build fails before the deploy starts.
system-scoped dependency with a local systemPath. Central will not accept a POM that points at a jar outside the repository.
gpg.skip is true, so the bundle ships unsigned. Central validation rejects any artifact without a .asc signature.
<name> is missing from the project metadata. Central Portal validation fails a POM without a human-readable project name.
<description> is missing. Central Portal requires a project description on every published POM.
<url> is missing from the project metadata. Central Portal requires a project URL.
<licenses> block is missing. Central Portal requires a declared licence on every published artifact.
<developers> block is missing. Central Portal requires at least one named developer with contact details.
<scm> block is missing. Central Portal requires connection and developerConnection pointing at the source repository.
maven-gpg-plugin is not configured. Every jar, POM and attached artifact must carry a GPG signature or the upload is rejected.
maven-source-plugin is not configured, so no -sources.jar is produced. Central requires a sources jar alongside the main artifact.
maven-javadoc-plugin is not configured, so no -javadoc.jar is produced. Central requires a javadoc jar alongside the main artifact.
No central-publishing-maven-plugin. Without the Portal publisher, mvn deploy has nowhere to send the bundle now that OSSRH is closed.
